The pale salt flats softly reflect that daylight rather than glaring white. Reduce the very bright golden shoulders, rope edges and canopy highlights; keep modest natural shadow beneath the canopy. The sky stays stormy in its existing layout, without intense blue contrasting against orange people. Both people must visibly inhabit the same illumination.
images.creator_feedback: Definitely preferred over the original lighting; no final publication decision.

images.title: Ilyra and the Unfinished Arch — consistent light
images.change: Keep Ilyra's exact face, swept head crest and arm/body crests, hand positions, indigo work tunic, belt and mallet, the same floating stone and wood cradle, arch, workers and city behind her. Replace the hard golden raking sunlight and vivid blue shadows with soft, broad neutral daylight, gently entering from the open side of this same terrace and bouncing through the space. The face, crest ridges, arm, timber and limestone share consistent lighting; soften the bright golden ridgelines and abrupt hot/cool differences. Skin should read as its original chalk-tan pigment with russet marks, not gold metal or glowing wax. Indigo cloth remains indigo, limestone remains warm pale stone, and the city retains its colours under the same soft daylight. Preserve the sense of air and depth with gentle values, not added haze.
